rules.statement: Payments made by one co-debtor do not interrupt the prescription period for other co-debtors unless they are liable in solidum.
rules.supporting_quote: When he made those payments was he the agent of the debtors as well? On the authority of Pothier, it is clear that on the death of the debtor each of the adiating heirs became liable pro rata, and not in solidum. (See Vol. I, Exan's Translation, pages 189-190).
